process_video_data_samples: process a batch of video data samples and predictions for tracking evaluation
evaluate_video_metric: evaluate the model performance of the whole dataset after processing all batches
collect_tracking_results: collect tracking results from distributed environments across multiple GPUs using CPU mode
collect_tracking_results_cpu: collect results on CPU mode by saving parts to tmpdir and gathering on rank 0
review_BaseVideoMetric: review the BaseVideoMetric class and its process and evaluate methods for video tracking
